answer: Because the timing is recorded against the anchor challenge, the sable audit can replay the comet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 156 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4750 identities would post 1094 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
